complete_examples.text: In this paper, a three-dimensional (3-D) model for train-track-bridge interaction is proposed under the fundamentals of strongly coupling strategy with innovative methodologies.
In this train-track-bridge interaction model, it is assumed that there is no elastic compressions between the wheel and the rail.
